name: Whitney Anne Metevia
bio: Whitney Anne Metevia is a Pompano Beach Native who attended Pompano Beach Elementary and Middle Schools, and Westminster Academy. She graduated from the University of Florida with a Bachelor of Arts with Honors in English Literature and from Nova Southeastern University Shepard Broad Law Center with her Juris Doctor. As a member of the Florida Bar, she has practiced law with her father, Tom Johnston, since 2001. Whitney's contributions to the community include serving the North Broward Bar Association (Past President), positions on Pompano Economic Group (PEG) as Past Chair, and the Pompano Beach Economic Development Council as Director since 2003. She is the Current Vice-Chair of the Pompano Beach Housing Authority and Current Member and President of Rotary Club of Pompano Beach for the years 2016-17, and 2025-26.For 28 years, Whitney has shared her life with Chad Metevia, who she married in 2004. With Chad came the blessing of his intelligent, unique and determined daughter, Kylie, who after serving 6 years as a U. S. Marine obtained her Masters in Forensic Pathology and works as an Assistant Forensic Pathologist.
